text:
Nora (platform): heads-up: planning a 'config cleanup' flow next Wed. Goal: remove long-unused feature flags safely. Thinking preview -> cohorted apply -> finalize. sync?
Eli (runtime): +1. Quick Q: criteria for removal?
Nora (platform): remove if `deprecated:true` AND `last_used_ts < 90d` AND not `safety:critical`. skip if `owner` missing.
Hana (infra): exclude infra toggles by default. we should provide a bulk-owner lookup endpoint to avoid per-flag calls.
Kai (ops): must have: dry-run preview per service, cohorted rollout (10/50/100), metric gates and snapshot for rollback. manual approval if >4 flags for a service.
Nora (platform): API draft: POST /v1/internal/configs/cleanup {dry_run:true, services:[], cohort_pct:10, owners_override:false} ; GET /v1/internal/configs/cleanup/{id}/preview
Eli (runtime): runtime will implement `is_cleanup_candidate(flag)` predicate and snapshot before change. keep snapshots for 30 days.
Hana (infra): bulk endpoint will return name, owners, region_scope and rate-limit headers. region-scoped flags skip unless owner approves.
Kai (ops): gates: error_rate delta >1% OR p95 +50ms OR 5xx +0.5% -> auto-pause and rollback. also emergency pause button that flips `config.cleanup.pause`.
Nora (platform): console UX: preview diffs, owner badges, bulk-approve, emergency pause, permalink to dry-run. RBAC internal-only.
Eli (runtime): telemetry events: cleanup.preview, cleanup.cohort.apply, cleanup.finalize with counts/service/sweep_id. include pre/post metric snapshots.
jenkins-bot: :white_check_mark: dry-run scheduled for Wed 03:00 PT ";
